name: Phrase-matched mix in
lesson:
## Start on the one that matters

A is playing; you have B cued to its first downbeat with its bass cut. PLAY B on bar 9 of A, exactly on the beat, bring its fader up over 8 bars, swap the bass at bar 17 and take A out over bars 21 to 25.

The press is scored to 30 ms. If B starts half a beat late the phrases are offset for the whole mix and every later move lands in the wrong place; there is no fader trick that fixes a late start. Count A out loud from bar 5 and press on "one".
